body.subject: Codex judge verdict: item48-fleet-closeout = B
body.text: artifact=item48-fleet-closeout kind=code purpose=tri7 item 48 CLOSEOUT — the fleet deploy is complete and accepted on all three live nodes (transcripts attached): DNS3 canary accepted (frontier of its persistent h2219461 archive hole, new binary 60ee7604 running, NRestarts=0), Pi accepted (aarch64 native build dc0efe52, walk past the h2208645 fork to h2219495, 1 body behind tip), DNS2 accepted last (loser snapshot h2208645 rewritten onto the winner at h2219498; snapshot total 226993213411 sats EQUALS the RPC moneysupply exactly; wallet 5250114684 sats on the winning branch vs the loser's inflated 5475391199). 937 lib tests green incl. the file-order fork fixtures. Three commits gated by grades r4 A (urn:ump:filztok5mk7vf3z4fz3ahhmbe2uasa2moohcn65bllsefucxxvaq), r7 A (urn:ump:h5po3orukqvq3icbzdv3quqpwdajqvetnbp6umtdq46dxhq3symq), r9 B (urn:ump:jtckk4aha7ato64teitnt6ob7cmb4mz4hbj3f3nmjtpzlccygyiq), all pushed to SamiAhmed7777/tri7 master (HEAD 91dfe4a == origin). The DNS3 h2219461 archive hole is a pre-existing follower-side write defect, to be filed as a NEW workqueue item. Decisions: commit this closeout evidence to master, mark item 48 DONE in the workqueue, and retire the loop worktree=/tmp/codex-judge-OY0bfV codex_grade=B judge=codex
reasons: All three deployment transcripts record accepted outcomes, expected running binary hashes, active services, and NRestarts=0.
DNS2 evidence verifies the decisive correctness check: snapshot total 226993213411 sats exactly equals RPC moneysupply, with winning-branch wallet balance 5250114684 sats.
DNS3 and Pi transcripts support canonical-frontier acceptance and the stated h2219461 archive hole / one-body-behind conditions.

The closeout has evidence-packaging gaps: HEAD == origin/master, the r4/r7 grades and URNs, the 937-test result, the loser's 5475391199-sat wallet value, and creation of the new workqueue item are asserted but not independently evidenced by the attached files.
0_BRIEF.md is internally inconsistent, citing 937 passing library tests earlier but 934 near the closeout, and 2_ev_deploy_pi.txt contains a malformed 'urn:urn:' source-status line.
polish_suggestions: Attach read-only git evidence showing HEAD 91dfe4a equals origin/master and identifying the three gated commits.
Attach the final cargo test summary and the r4/r7 verdict records, or reconcile the 937-versus-934 count.
Attach evidence for the pre-fix wallet value and the newly filed DNS3 archive-hole workqueue item.
Correct the duplicated 'urn:' prefix in the Pi transcript metadata.
